findings.text: the new unit test asserts release == CompilationRelease(before=3, after=3, collected_objects=11) while _live_executable_count is monkeypatched to the constant 3, so both sides of the before/after pair come from the value the test itself supplied; the assertion cannot fail if the release drops nothing, and 'after' would equal 'before' whatever the code did. The test still guards that jax.clear_caches() is called once and that history is appended and collect's return recorded, but the counts carry no independent evidence. This is the same shape the earlier review recorded at this file, and it is not addressed by the gained evidence commits.
